intent: Compare the old receipt ex-VAT total from /uploads/ with today's catalogue prices for the same items; return <YES> if the absolute difference ≤ 2 EUR, else <NO>.
success_criteria: Answer references the exact receipt file path
Old ex-VAT total is the parsed SUBTOTAL from the receipt
Today's ex-VAT total is SUM(qty × catalogue price_cents)/100 using exact + fuzzy SKU matching (0/O, 1/I, 5/S, 8/B, 2/Z); discontinued SKUs contribute 0
Difference = abs(today_ex - old_ex) compared to euro_threshold

args: SELECT product_sku, price_cents FROM product_variants WHERE product_sku IN ($all_candidate_skus_quoted);

args.message: Receipt subtotal (ex-VAT): {old_ex:.2f} EUR. Today's ex-VAT total: {today_ex:.2f} EUR. Difference: {diff:.2f} EUR. Within the {euro_threshold} EUR threshold? {outcome_token}
